entities.summary: Sheikh Ali Ilyas (b. 1979-12-05, Shekhan District) was a religious figure or clergy of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Shekhan District and Iraq. Known in the fields of iraq, architects & engineers, asia.
